text: Applying current legacy custody rules developed for traditional assets to digital assets is inconsistent with the foundations of decentralization, because the very nature of a decentralized system mandates the avoidance and eradication of intermediaries for business transactions.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
abstract: From the perspective of decentralization, the application of current legacy rules around custody of traditional assets is inconsistent with decentralization foundations.

value: viewed from the perspective of decentralization
